**Wrote the 4.2.0 entry to [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md).**

`commits.log` has 380 commits but only 127 actually merged, per `merged-prs.tsv` — lots of near-duplicate `fix()` titles across modules in the raw log never landed. I built the notes from the merged sheet only: 1 feature, 8 fixes, 1 breaking change.

Flagging the breaking one: `#4223` changes expired-token responses from `403` to `401`, filed as a fix but any client checking status codes will notice.

Next: confirm the wording on the allowlist and paginator fixes reads right to you, then it's ready.
